purpose: Region-defining combat support items, achievement passives, Archaeology relic chains, and cross-region equipment dependencies.

records.name: Hard Morytania Barrows rewards
records.detail: Rewards: Prayer drain is halved in Barrows, Barrows rune rewards are doubled, Barrows chest loot can be banked directly from the reward chest

records.name: Seers' Village combat achievement rewards
records.detail: Rewards: Enhanced Excalibur healing progression, Elite tier doubles Enhanced Excalibur's healing duration, +2 percentage points to enchanted-bolt special-effect activation chance

records.name: Elite Fremennik combat rewards
records.detail: Rewards: Dagannoth Kings drop noted bones, 10% more auto-attack damage and 5% more ability damage against the Dagannoth Kings

records.name: Tirannwn combat achievement rewards
records.detail: Rewards: 5% increased damage against shadow creatures in Prifddinas, 5% increased damage against elves in Prifddinas, 5% increased damage against dark beasts, 5% chance not to consume an attuned crystal bow or ward charge

records.name: Hard Desert Keris upgrade
records.detail: Effects: Against Kalphites and Scabarites, the Keris hit-chance bonus rises from 15% to 25%, Triple-damage chance rises from about 2.5% to 5%
requirements: Contact! for the base Keris in the normal game

records.name: Slayer Lodge progression
records.detail: The tier-3 stand grants the effects of the placed Slayer helmet without wearing it, but not the helmet's stats or teleports. · Unlocks: Tier 1: +1% damage on Anachronia, Tier 2: +3% damage on Anachronia, Tier 3: +6% damage on Anachronia plus the Slayer helmet stand

records.name: Totem of Vitality
records.detail: The April 2026 Aura Overhaul moved the former Might of Het effect here and removed the old weekly totem charging upkeep. · Effects: Increases maximum life points by 25%, capped at 1,500 additional life points

records.name: Spirit cape passive
records.detail: Effects: Permanently reduces familiar special-move point costs by 20% after purchase

records.name: Berserker's Fury relic chain
records.detail: Dharok's Memento requires the Barrows Amulet of the forsaken plus the Saradominist I Lock of hair, so the important necklace dependency is visible instead of being hidden behind the relic name. · Effects: Up to 5.5% increased damage at lower current life points · Unlocks: Berserker's Fury

records.name: Heightened Senses relic chain
records.detail: Effects: Increases maximum adrenaline by 10% · Unlocks: Cup of Nectar, Heightened Senses
requirements: Kantharos cup used with the Everlight beam

records.name: Death Ward relic chain
records.detail: Keep both regions visible unless Equilibrium auto-completion explicitly bypasses the Armadyl turn-in or supplies the relic directly. · Effects: 5% damage reduction below 50% life points, 10% damage reduction below 25% life points · Unlocks: Ring of Solomon, Death Ward
requirements: Kandarin: restore the Aviansie dreamcoat from Stormguard Citadel
Asgarnia: give the restored artefact to Armadyl at Armadyl's Tower

records.name: Vyre combat and Sunspear progression
records.detail: Vyrewatch are not a Salve-amulet method. Their important progression is the Ivandis/blisterwood/Sunspear system plus corpse-cremation bonuses. · Unlocks: Blisterwood/Sunspear damage access against vyres, Up to +100 Sunspear/blisterwood damage from the 500-corpse cremation progression, Automatic Prayer and Firemaking XP from Sunspear cremations, Morytania elite achievement bonus to vyre cremation Prayer and Firemaking XP

records.name: Salve amulet (e)
records.detail: This is one of Morytania's strongest cross-region combat support unlocks because it materially improves undead methods outside Morytania, including Lumbridge Catacombs skeletons, bound skeletons, armoured phantoms, and armoured zombies. · Keep Morytania as the normal self-sufficient acquisition region unless Equilibrium explicitly grants the amulet or quest rewards globally. · Effects: +20% damage against undead enemies, +20% hit chance against undead enemies, Stacks with the full Slayer helmet, Void Knight equipment, the Undead Slayer perk, and the Undead Slayer ability, The bonus is on-hit and does not increase damage-over-time abilities or conjures
requirements: Haunted Mine for the base salve amulet
Lair of Tarn Razorlor for Tarn's diary and the enchantment

records.name: Amulet of the forsaken to Berserker's Fury
records.category: combat necklace and Archaeology relic ingredient
records.detail: Both the Barrows amulet and the Saradominist I/Everlight side of the relic chain are Morytania content, making this a real single-region combat relic unlock rather than a generic Archaeology passive. · Quest auto-completion can satisfy quest gates, but it should not silently remove the Barrows item dependency unless Equilibrium says the relic itself is granted. · Effects: Berserker's Fury deals up to 5.5% more damage as current life points fall below maximum, Consumes 250 monolith energy when active, Does not stack with Dharok's set effect · Unlocks: Amulet of the forsaken as a Barrows reward, Dharok's Memento by combining the amulet with the Lock of hair, Berserker's Fury relic power
requirements: Saradominist I collection progression for the Lock of hair
Amulet of the forsaken from Barrows

source.title: Amulet of the forsaken to Berserker's Fury

records.name: Igneous cape progression
records.detail: The Zuk encounter supplies the igneous stone, but the stone upgrades a TokHaar-Kal cape from Karamja's Fight Kiln. A planner that shows only Misthalin materially understates the cape chain. · Display this as Karamja + Misthalin under the current Senntisten working map. If Equilibrium later assigns Senntisten differently, update only that side of the chain. · Unlocks: Igneous Kal-Ket, Igneous Kal-Xil, Igneous Kal-Mej, Igneous Kal-Mor, Igneous Kal-Zuk after the hard-mode flawless requirement and all four style capes
requirements: Karamja: Fire cape for the one-time Fight Kiln entry payment
Karamja: Fight Kiln completion for a TokHaar-Kal cape
Misthalin working Senntisten mapping: defeat TzKal-Zuk without checkpoints for an igneous stone

records.name: Ring of Vigour and passive conversion
records.detail: Forinthry is the normal base-ring source. Treat Extinction as a separate quest-auto-completion dependency rather than a second elective region. · Effects: Retains 10% adrenaline after using an ultimate ability, Warped-gem conversion makes the effect permanently active without equipping the ring
requirements: 50,000 Dungeoneering tokens for the base ring
Extinction for the warped-gem passive conversion in the normal game

source.title: Ring of Vigour and passive conversion

records.name: Bonecrusher
records.category: post-remaster combat drop-cleaner and Prayer sustain infrastructure
records.detail: Use the 11 May 2026 remaster cost and requirement, not the older 34,000-token version. · Effects: Automatically converts configured bone drops into normal burying Prayer XP, Combines with Dungeoneering prayer necklaces for Prayer sustain

records.name: Charming imp
records.detail: This is especially relevant to the listed Waterbirth Dagannoth charm-farming method. · Effects: Automatically collects charms and spirit gems; selected charm types can instead be converted into Summoning XP

records.name: NopeNopeNope spider combat perk
records.detail: Effects: Tier 1 permanent breeding-log perk: 2% increased damage against all spiders including Araxxor/Araxxi, Tier 2 farm-totem configuration: 3% increased damage against all spiders including Araxxor/Araxxi
requirements: Spider breeding-log progression at Manor Farm

records.name: King of Beasts bomb-conservation perk
records.category: Ranch Out of Time combat passive
records.detail: Effects: Tier 1: 5% chance to conserve a bomb when thrown, Tier 2: 10% chance to conserve a bomb when thrown

records.name: No Fear Meteor Strike perk
records.category: Ranch Out of Time combat passive
records.detail: Effects: Tier 1: 20% increased critical-hit chance for Meteor Strike, Tier 2: 40% increased critical-hit chance for Meteor Strike

records.name: Armoured Hide Barricade perk
records.category: Ranch Out of Time combat passive
records.detail: Effects: Tier 1 increases Barricade duration by 3 ticks, Tier 2 increases Barricade duration by 6 ticks

records.name: Guthix staff and Claws of Guthix access
records.detail: Mage Arena is Wilderness geography, so Forinthry is the normal acquisition region unless Equilibrium publishes an exception. · Unlocks: Guthix staff, Claws of Guthix special attack, Divine Storm outside the Mage Arena
requirements: Complete the Mage Arena encounter and choose Guthix for the initial reward
Cast Divine Storm 100 times on Mage Arena mages for the extended unlock

source.title: Guthix staff and Claws of Guthix access

records.name: Dreadnips
records.detail: Track the permanent reward gate without importing old boss-use or damage advice. · Unlocks: Ability to claim and deploy Dreadnips
requirements: Spectate another player's Dominion Tower match

records.name: Holy wrench
records.detail: Morytania supplies the normal gameplay acquisition. Resolve the quests through the Equilibrium quest overlay separately. · Effects: Increases Prayer restored by supported prayer-restoring potions while carried or worn, After Pieces of Hate, Dungeoneering prayer necklaces restore 10% more Prayer
requirements: Pieces of Hate for the Dungeoneering prayer-necklace interaction

records.name: Demon horn necklace
records.detail: The 11 May 2026 Dungeoneering remaster reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 90 to 75 while retaining the 35,000-token cost. · Effects: Restores 50 to 150 Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried or supported ashes/ghost remains are processed with the attuned ectoplasmator

records.name: Split dragontooth necklace
records.detail: The 11 May 2026 remaster reduced its Dungeoneering requirement to 41 and token cost to 15,500. · Effects: Restores Prayer from qualifying buried bones and works with Bonecrusher-processed bones

records.name: Asylum surgeon's ring
records.detail: Show both possible region mappings without claiming both are required. Official Equilibrium quest locality can resolve this later. · Region status: unresolved_misthalin_morytania_boundary
requirements: Complete a replay in under 37 minutes

records.name: Fight Cauldron obsidian armour progression
records.category: TzekHaar combat support and cape progression
records.detail: The protection applies through the TzKal-Zuk encounter, including Zuk. The obsidian helm accuracy effect applies to the surrounding TzekHaar but not Zuk himself. This gives Karamja continuing value after the TokHaar-Kal prerequisite is obtained. · Quest auto-completion can satisfy the normal quest gate, but Karamja remains the Fight Cauldron and obsidian-shard source unless Equilibrium explicitly supplies the equipment. · Unlocks: Obsidian armour crafted from Fight Cauldron obsidian shards, Up to 55% damage reduction from obsidian monsters in Fight Kiln and TzKal-Zuk encounters, Obsidian helms with increased accuracy against TzekHaar wave monsters, Fight Cauldron TokKul donation for an additional 10 percentage points of obsidian-armour damage reduction while active
requirements: The Brink of Extinction in the normal game
Fight Cauldron access for obsidian shards

records.name: TokKul-Zo
records.category: TzHaar and TzekHaar combat support ring
records.detail: This is a Karamja support unlock for the wave portions of the Zuk encounter and for the earlier TzHaar progression. Do not describe it as a 10% damage bonus against Zuk himself. · Effects: 10% increased damage against TzHaar, TokHaar, TzekHaar and Igneous TzekHaar, The damage effect works on TzekHaar waves but not TzKal-Zuk himself, Teleports around TzHaar City including Fight Cave, Fight Kiln and Fight Cauldron
requirements: The Elder Kiln in the normal game

records.name: Corporeal Beast holy-elixir supply
records.category: combat-support and Blessed flask ingredient supply
records.detail: The Corporeal Beast cavern entrance is in the Wilderness. The lair itself is not dangerous Wilderness territory, but Forinthry is the useful region dependency for entering the normal self-supply chain. Holy elixir can also come from the tormented wraith, so this row describes the primary practical regional source rather than claiming Corp is the only source. · Unlocks: Holy elixir drop source, Spirit shield and sigil progression, Necrite and phasmatite stone-spirit supply relevant to Blessed flask crafting
requirements: Summer's End for the normal-game Corporeal Beast progression

records.name: Blessed flask production chain
records.detail: This is a real region-planning chain because no trading makes the ingredient sources matter, but it would be wrong to display Desert + Tirannwn + Karamja + Forinthry as four unconditional required picks while alternate supply routes and the unresolved Arc exist. Keep the full pressure visible instead. · Re-evaluate individual ingredient gates when Equilibrium publishes external-area handling, quest auto-completion details, or League-specific supply passives. · Effects: Holds up to 80 doses of extreme prayer in one inventory slot, At level 99 Prayer, 80 doses can represent up to 45,200 Prayer points before other modifiers, Holy wrench increases the Prayer restored per extreme-prayer dose and works with the Blessed flask · Region pressure: Desert: the normal direct source for the 1,200 red sandstone used in the shell chain; alternate account sources can weaken this as a hard region gate., Tirannwn: crystal-flecked sandstone and 5,000 harmonic dust are naturally supplied through Prifddinas; some alternate sources mean this is recorded as pressure rather than an unconditional hard gate., Karamja: Holy water production is learned through Legends' Quest and uses the Kharazi Jungle water pool., Forinthry: Corporeal Beast is the practical normal self-supply source for the holy elixir and several required stone spirits; the tormented wraith is an alternate holy-elixir source., External unresolved: 250 alaea sea salt comes from the Arc/Wushanko chain, which is not currently assigned to an Equilibrium elective region.
requirements: Blessed flask shell and glorious silvthril chain
